module: Game editor extension that hosts the Flowgraph editor (visual node graph editor for gameplay, scenarios and missions). It creates the main window (flowgraph/main) and all the auxiliary windows (overview, stateView, events, examples, properties, variables, projectSettings, history, welcome, nodelibrary, execution, search, references, garbageDebug), manages the current manager (core_flowgraphManager), opening/saving of .flow.json files, autosave, recent files, editing shortcuts and registration of the flowgraph.general.* and flowgraph.debug.* preferences.
notes: The drawing functions and the onEditor* hooks only work when the editor is active and initialized (onEditorInitialized creates the windows and the ui_flowgraph_editor context).

Project files: *.flow.json; macros: *.macro.flow.json; autosaves in flowgraphEditor/autoSaves/ (name <timestamp>_<project name>.flow.json), default interval 120 s (preference flowgraph.general.autosaveInterval, 30-600).
setManager only changes the manager at the next onEditorGui (unless instant = true).

Inconsistencies in the code: save() tests the preference flowgraph.general.editorDebug while the registered one is flowgraph.debug.editorDebug (so the test is always "false"), saveFile() logs an error for a transient project but does not stop; onClientStartMission writes M.requesteEditor (typo) so requestedEditor is never reset to false; showNodeReferences calls winReferences:searchFor which does not exist; the restore loop in onEditorGui uses a global variable `done` that is always nil; onWindowMenuItem calls open() before its local declaration (not exported, not used).
M.onUpdate is the small "FG Monitor" window shown when the editor is disabled but showSmallFgWindow is true.

allowTooltip.desc: True when the mouse has been still for more than 0.5 s and no button is pressed: allows tooltips to be displayed.

forceOpen.desc: Initial values {states = true, log = true} indicating views to force open.

pushedNodeLibActionMap.desc: True if the 'NodeLibrary' action map was pushed by a search window.

requestedEditor.desc: If true, onClientStartMission activates the editor and opens Flowgraph.

showSmallFgWindow.desc: Display of the small "FG Monitor" window (BoolPtr).

switchToSmallWindow.desc: If true, the next drawEditor disables the editor and shows the small window.

addHistory.desc: Schedules a project history (undo) snapshot with a title; the snapshot is taken later (delayedHistorySnapshot). Also prints the title in the console.

graph.desc: Graph concerned; nil = current graph; any other type (e.g. false) = no graph.

arrowControllableWindowCall.desc: Calls a method on the current keyboard-controllable window (search, node library), if there is one.

autoSave.desc: Autosave: if the timer has elapsed and the project is editable and not transient, writes a copy to flowgraphEditor/autoSaves/ and re-arms the timer.

closeCurrent.desc: Closes the current project (removeManager) and switches to the first remaining manager or nil.

drawContextMenus.desc: Draws the "CreateNodeContentMenu" popup (node library at position mgr.newNodePos).

drawEditor.desc: Draws the full editor for the frame: manager, main window, all auxiliary windows, node double-click handling, autosave. Called from onEditorGui.

drawRestoreMenu.desc: Draws the "Restore..." submenu listing the autosave files grouped by original project (UTC date).

getManager.desc: Returns the flowgraph manager displayed in the editor.

isActionMapEnabled.desc: Indicates whether the "<map>ActionMap" action map is active and enabled.

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called when a mission/level starts on the client side: if requestedEditor is true, activates the editor and opens the Flowgraph window.

onDeserialized.desc: Restore hook after Lua reload: stores the open windows (data.windows) and the current manager name (data.currentMgrName).

onEditorActivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is activated: hides the small FG Monitor window.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is deactivated: pops the FlowgraphMain and Flowgraph action maps.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every frame by the editor: handles action maps, tooltips, manager change, then draws the editor (drawEditor) if the main window is visible.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called when the editor is ready: creates the windows, the "Flowgraph Editor" menu entry (Gameplay group), the node editor context, restores the open windows and declares the flowgraphTransform edit mode.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Preferences registration hook: 'flowgraph' category with 'general' (pins, recent files, autosave...) and 'debug' (editorDebug, displayIds...) subcategories.

onSerialize.desc: Save hook before Lua reload: returns the windows' state and the current manager name (empty table if the windows do not exist).

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: draws the small "FG Monitor" window (button to enlarge the editor) when showSmallFgWindow is true.

open.desc: Opens (shows) the main window of the Flowgraph editor.

openFile.desc: Opens a .flow.json file: either as a new manager (and makes it current), or by reloading the data into the current manager. Updates the folder and recent files.

fCbData.desc: File dialog data, with the filepath field.

openAsNewManager.desc: true to create a new manager.

keepSavedDirs.desc: Passed to loadManager (keep the saved folders).

save.desc: Saves the current project: saveFile if it already has a name/folder, otherwise opens the "Save as" dialog. Re-arms the autosave.

saveAsFile.desc: Sets the project's folder and file name from the chosen path, then saves.

saveCurrent.desc: Saves the current graph: the macro (saveMacro) if it is a macro with a path, otherwise the project (save).

saveFile.desc: Writes the project to savedDir/savedFilename (indented JSON). Refuses if the project has no name or is not stopped (runningState ~= 'stopped'), marks the graphs clean, renames "New Project" after the file and updates the recent files.

saveMacro.desc: Saves a macro: opens the "Unsaved macros" popup if child macros are modified, otherwise writes to the existing path (macroPath) or opens the dialog (.macro.flow.json).

setManager.desc: Request to change the displayed manager (applied at the next onEditorGui, or immediately with instant).

instant.desc: Apply immediately to the local variable mgr.

showNodeReferences.desc: Opens the References window and asks it to search for a node. BUG: calls winReferences:searchFor which does not exist in references.lua.

uiAutoConnectShortcut.desc: Shortcut: automatically links the output pins of the left node to the free input pins of the right node, based on pin similarity (nodelib:ratePinSimilarity) and if the link is possible. Works with a selected link, a node with a single neighbor, or two selected nodes.

uiDisconnectShortcut.desc: Shortcut: deletes the selected links, or the links connecting the selected nodes to the rest of the graph (failing that, those between selected nodes).

uiFindShortcut.desc: Shortcut: opens the Search window and puts the focus in the search field.

uiFocusNodesShortcut.desc: Shortcut: recenters the graph view on the selection, or on all content if there is no selection.

uiHideShortcut.desc: Shortcut: toggles the visibility of the selected links; with no link selected, hides or shows the links of the selected nodes. Adds a history snapshot.

hide.desc: Value applied to the links of the selected nodes when no link is selected.

uiShowSourceShortcut.desc: Shortcut: opens the file explorer on the source file of the selected node (node.sourcePath), if there is exactly one.

uiToggleCategoryShortcut.desc: Shortcut: toggles the dynamic mode (toggleDynamicMode) of the selected node, if there is exactly one.

windowsMenu.desc: Draws the content of the "Windows" menu: one entry per window (checked if visible) and "Open All" / "Close All".
